f.title: Share implementation and maintenance of the shared REMS infrastructure and jointly carry out the assessments
f.statement: Applicants in a shared system REMS generally share in the implementation and maintenance of any database and infrastructure (e.g. call centre) used for the program and are jointly responsible for carrying out all or most components of the REMS assessments.

f.title: Use a single, shared system with the RLD for any ETASU as an ANDA holder, unless FDA grants a waiver
f.statement: Under section 505-1(i)(1)(B) of the FD&C Act, a holder of an ANDA approved under section 505(j) must use a single, shared system with the reference listed drug for any ETASU, unless FDA waives this requirement and permits the ANDA to use a separate, comparable aspect of the ETASU.
